description: This file defines the 'Tutorial' entity class mapped to the 'tutorials' table in a PostgreSQL database using Jakarta Persistence API (JPA). It includes fields for id, title, description, and published status, along with constructors, getters, setters, and a toString method.

classes.name: Tutorial
classes.description: Entity class representing a tutorial with id, title, description, and published status, mapped to the tutorials table in the database.

methods.name: Tutorial()
methods.description: Default constructor for the Tutorial class.

methods.name: Tutorial(String title, String description, boolean published)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor for creating a Tutorial instance with specified title, description, and published status.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the id of the tutorial.

methods.name: getTitle()
methods.description: Returns the title of the tutorial.

methods.name: setTitle(String title)
methods.description: Sets the title of the tutorial.

methods.name: getDescription()
methods.description: Returns the description of the tutorial.

methods.name: setDescription(String description)
methods.description: Sets the description of the tutorial.

methods.name: isPublished()
methods.description: Returns whether the tutorial is published.

methods.name: setPublished(boolean isPublished)
methods.description: Sets the published status of the tutorial.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Tutorial object.
